concept.title: Scenario 1 — Standard Multi-Column Table Reference
concept.shortdesc: This pattern is fully covered in: Tables › Scenario 1 — Standard multi-column table .

conbody.p: This pattern is fully covered in: Tables › Scenario 1 — Standard multi-column table. Refer to that scenario for the input/output detail. The notes below explain only the topic-type classification aspect.

A heading containing a lookup keyword combined with a multi-column table as the primary body content triggers reference classification. Non-table prose before the table is wrapped in a <section> inside <refbody>. For the <simpletable> construct output, see the BPG scenario above.
